'''Shivaz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who accompanied a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] into the [[Nightmare Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. Shivaz successfully resisted the corrupting influence of the Nightmare Lands as they progressed, but when they reached the [[Dark Heart]], Shivaz ignored the soldiers' warnings and entered&mdash;only to be driven completely insane by the entity [[Sel-Makor]] that lived within.
